claim_one_line: THE LINE'S ORDER AS A QUOTIENT OF HYPERCHARGE (P-296; B1703's coincidence law derived; no data): in B1656's frame a field of charge q on the line w = alpha tau + b has the twist (q alpha, 2 q b), and three identities hold -- a charge shift by the line's order N multiplies a sector's bilinear, residues, weights, M and Y by one phase (thc(a + k, b + 2m) = e^{4 pi i m a} thc(a, b); 1.1e-14), the left-right swap transposes them (bil(y, x) = bil(x, y)^T, M(y, x) = M(x, y)^T, and Y(y, x) = Y(x, y)^T because eps S is symmetric for every S in span(i, j, k); to 1e-15, the control S = 1 breaks it), and negating both twists leaves them unchanged (bil(-x, -y; u) = -bil(x, y; -u), the torus's involution; 1.3e-15) -- so two sectors have the same singular values whenever their charges 6Y agree mod N up to swap and sign: d = e if N | 4 or 5 (Y_e = Y_d^T at 5, minimal SU(5)), u = d if N | 6, u = e if N | 2 or 7, which is B1703's computed law, now derived in the 'if' direction (59 of 59 unmasked pairs on two lines of each order 1-12 agree); the converse stays B1703's census. P-296 had restated the law from B1723's rows without B1703 and without u = e; corrected. 0 of 19.
